source: Postgres catalogs read in a READ ONLY transaction against backend/.env database. No credentials or learner records.

constraints.name: modules_programme_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (programme_id) REFERENCES curriculum.programmes(programme_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: quiz_answers_question_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (question_id) REFERENCES curriculum.quiz_questions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: quiz_component_links_quiz_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (quiz_id) REFERENCES curriculum.quizzes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: quiz_course_links_quiz_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (quiz_id) REFERENCES curriculum.quizzes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: quiz_questions_question_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((question_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['single_choice'::character varying, 'multiple_choice'::character varying, 'true_false'::character varying, 'matching'::character varying, 'image_matching'::character varying, 'keywords'::character varying, 'fill_gap'::character varying, 'ordering'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: quiz_questions_quiz_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (quiz_id) REFERENCES curriculum.quizzes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: quizzes_default_question_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((default_question_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['single_choice'::character varying, 'multiple_choice'::character varying, 'true_false'::character varying, 'matching'::character varying, 'image_matching'::character varying, 'keywords'::character varying, 'fill_gap'::character varying, 'ordering'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: quizzes_package_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((package_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['xml'::character varying, 'scorm'::character varying, 'excel'::character varying, 'csv'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: quizzes_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['draft'::character varying, 'published'::character varying, 'pending'::character varying, 'validating'::character varying, 'trash'::character varying, 'private'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: week_templates_programme_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (programme_id) REFERENCES curriculum.programmes(programme_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT VALID
